g.text: STANDARD HOOKS AND FINISHED BEND DIAMETERS
ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES. D IS THE FINISHED INSIDE BEND DIAMETER AND INCLUDES SPRINGBACK; IT IS NOT LESS THAN THE ACI 318-14 MINIMUM.
A OR G IS THE TOTAL EXTRA LENGTH OF BAR THE HOOK ACCOUNTS FOR, MEASURED OUT-TO-OUT. ADD IT TO THE DETAILED DIMENSIONS TO GET THE ORDERING LENGTH (ACI 315-99 SECTIONS 2.3 AND 3.7.2).
J IS THE OUT-TO-OUT HEIGHT OF A 180 DEGREE HOOK AND H THE HEIGHT OF A TIE HOOK. SHOW THEM ON THE DRAWING WHERE EITHER IS A CONTROLLING DIMENSION (SECTION 3.7.2).
SEISMIC 135 DEGREE HOOKS HAVE A 6db TAIL NOT LESS THAN 75 mm AND ARE REQUIRED FOR HOOPS AND CROSSTIES IN SPECIAL MOMENT FRAMES.
TIE HOOK VALUES ARE PUBLISHED FOR No. 10 THROUGH No. 25 ONLY (ACI 315-99 FIG. 10 NOTE 8); LARGER TIES ARE DERIVED FROM THE BEND GEOMETRY.
VALUES FOR DB10, DB16, DB20, DB28, DB32, DB36 ARE SCALED FROM TABLE 1 BY THE RATIO OF THE ACTUAL BAR DIAMETER TO THE ACI DESIGNATION IT IS GOVERNED BY, AND ROUNDED UP.
